headline: How Investors Are Reacting To Ameren (AEE) Reaffirming Earnings Outlook And Massive Data Center Investment Plans
summary: Ameren Corporation reported past second-quarter 2026 results with revenue of US$2,092 million versus US$2,221 million a year earlier, while net income rose to US$314 million and diluted EPS from continuing operations increased to US$1.13. Alongside reaffirming its 2026 earnings guidance of US$5.25 to US$5.45 per share, Ameren outlined a long-term US$71.00 billion infrastructure investment pipeline and a growing large-load customer portfolio anchored by data center projects for companies such...
